description: This file contains shell script functions and logic for configuring and managing 3G network interfaces using various device-specific commands and scripts. It defines functions for initialization, setup, and teardown of 3G connections, reading configuration from JSON variables, and interacting with modem devices via GCOM scripts.

methods.name: proto_3g_init_config
methods.description: Initializes 3G protocol configuration by setting default values and adding string configuration options.

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 3G connection based on JSON configuration, device interaction, and modem response parsing.
